comment: TEST FIXTURE. These answers exercise the scorer and carry no legal judgment.

issues.title: Delivery period differs between agreement and schedule
issues.description: Ten days in the agreement, thirty in the schedule.

evidence.quote: within ten (10) days of each order
within thirty (30) days of each order

issues.rationale: Both periods cannot apply to the same order.

issues.title: Fixed price against a surcharge right
issues.description: The agreement fixes the price; the schedule lets the supplier add to it.

evidence.quote: fixed at five euros per widget for the first year
fuel surcharge of up to two euros per widget at any time

issues.rationale: A price cannot be fixed and increasable at once.

issues.title: Surcharge

evidence.quote: fuel surcharge of up to two euros per widget at any time

issues.rationale: The toy playbook rejects any surcharge in the first year.

issues.title: Delivery period in the agreement
issues.description: Stance on the ten day period.

evidence.quote: within ten (10) days of each order

issues.rationale: Ten days is within the fourteen the toy playbook accepts.

issues.title: Annex R is not on the file
issues.description: The returns regime cannot be assessed without the annex.

evidence.quote: Returns are handled as set out in Annex R.
